Definition: pointed; (used with the article as a proper name) Senuah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Senuah means pointed, or bristling. It appears as Hasenuah in the Benjamite genealogy, the father in the line of Sallu, and as Senuah in Nehemiah's list, the father of Judah, who was second over the city. Two records, two spellings, one family name kept on both sides of the exile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name kept in two lists is a person God did not lose track of, before the exile or after it.
